Lightweight in-memory session manager for Supranim core.

This module provides the minimal building blocks that were missing from core: session creation, lookup, renewal, expiry, CSRF tokens and flash notifications — without requiring a database or the out-of-tree supranim-session provider.

For persistent, multi-process or DB-backed sessions (users table, remember-me, 2FA, email confirmation) use supranim-session. This core store is process-local and suitable for single-instance apps, tests and as a foundation for custom providers.

Thread safety: all SessionStore mutations are guarded by pkg/threading/rwlock. Read paths use readWith, writes use writeWith, matching the convention in supranim-session.

SessionStore = ref object

Process-local session container.
